senses.gloss: c. (שְׁכַח II) = h. מָצוּי, found, on hand; frequent; likely.Ḥag. 5ᵃ, v. זוּזָא I.
units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 85b:9">B. Mets. 85ᵇ</cite> <he>דהוה ש׳ אליהו גביה</he> whom Elijah used to visit.
<cite ref="Taanit 23b:15">Taan. 23ᵇ</cite> <he>משום דאתתא ש׳ וכ׳</he> because the wife is usually at home, and gives the poor bread &c., v. <cite ref="E00678"><he>הֲנָיָיה</he></cite> ch.
<cite ref="Shabbat 78a:2">Sabb. 78ᵃ</cite> <he>יין שתייתו ש׳ … לא ש׳</he> wine is used ordinarily for drinking, extraordinarily for medicine.

<cite ref="Beitzah 2b:13">Bets. 2ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>מילתא דלא ש׳</he> a case of rare occurrence. Sabb. l. c. <he>כל מילתא דש׳ ולא ש׳</he> whenever a thing is used ordinarily for one purpose, and rarely for another purpose; a. fr.
